description:
When you go on a picnic, the bus always causes trouble, and when you go on a trip, your accommodation always loses power. Even if you eat a group meal, you can only get an upset stomach on your own. Junmok is a person who is unlucky to be born with. Still, when I entered college, I decided to experience many things I had never done before, and I also wanted to have a strong relationship with the handsome and cool Alpha! Innate luck did not improve just because you entered a prestigious university. It's especially strange when you get involved with Gongju Lim, the famous person on campus and the protagonist of rumors.
